mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse_stock s INNER JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = s.tenant_id INNER JOIN spare_parts p ON p.id = s.spare_part_id AND p.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.quantity < s.min_stock_quantity
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{warehouseId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spare_parts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{sparePartId}

SELECT s.id, s.tenant_id, s.warehouse_id, w.site_id, w.warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, w.enabled AS warehouse_enabled, s.spare_part_id, p.part_code, p.name AS part_name, p.spec, p.unit, p.enabled AS spare_part_enabled, s.quantity, s.min_stock_quantity, CASE WHEN s.quantity < s.min_stock_quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS low_stock, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM warehouse_stock s INNER JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = s.tenant_id INNER JOIN spare_parts p ON p.id = s.spare_part_id AND p.tenant_id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.id = #{id}
